finding_key: packages/cli/src/client/url.ts::new empty-segment rejection in `seg()` fires on the *unconfigured workspace* path that `resolveconfig` deliberately produces, breaking every command — including offline `--dry-run` previews
evidence: Verified against the supplied sources: resolveConfig (packages/cli/src/config/config.ts) returns workspace: '' on every fallback path, and apiV1Base (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts) unconditionally calls seg(config.workspace), which throws on the empty string; printDryRun (dry-run.ts:19) routes through the same builder, so unconfigured --dry-run previews that formerly printed and exited 0 now error with "Invalid identifier \"\"". The mechanism and both cited consequences are real; the claim only overstates impact slightly since live commands with an empty workspace already failed (server 404), just with a different error. Severity is minor: it only affects unconfigured setups, but the dry-run regression and the unhelpful error message are genuine.
